title: Helion Energy arrow button
description: A small square outlined button (44px, 50px on desktop, 4px corners) holding a thin right arrow. As it scrolls through the window a filled block sweeps across it from left to right; on hover it fills with the primary colour.
notes: tone="quiet" for the light page (hairline border, pale arrow), tone="strong" over photos and dark bands
the sweep is a CSS view timeline; off under reduced motion
